annotations.title: Semantic search over EU case law

description: Find CJEU / General Court judgments, orders and AG opinions by meaning. Returns cases with celex (the id works with lex_get_document), case number, ECLI, court, date, score and a summary. Cost: 5 credits (15 with hyde, refunded to 5 if it falls back). Leave hyde off unless a short keyword query returns little.

filters.description: Optional filters. Keys other than these are an error (date_from, not dateFrom).

court.description: Court name as indexed, e.g. "Court of Justice", "General Court".

language.description: Same as the top-level language, which wins.

hyde.description: LLM rewriting of a terse keyword query for better recall (+1–3 s; 15 credits).

include.description: ["text"] returns each judgment's full text (large; bounded by maxChars).

limit.description: Max cases (plan cap: FREE 10, STARTER 20, PROFESSIONAL 50, higher 100). One result per case.

maxChars.description: Character budget for hit texts when include is ["text"].

min_score.description: Similarity floor. Default ≈0.7 server-side; a lower value (e.g. 0.5) returns more hits, 0 disables it.

query.description: Natural-language question or description of the legal issue.

name: lex_semantic_case_law
title: Semantic search over EU case law
